(api-gui-forms-easingpreview)=
## EasingPreview

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/easing_preview/easing_preview.hpp>
class EasingPreview final : public Control
```

EasingPreview is a retained animation conformance surface that owns an AnimationTimeline, one revocable frame lease, configurable tracks/style/title/marker size, authored and effective motion policy, deterministic phase, painter recording, and image semantics. Hidden, detached, paused, or reduced states never create a perpetual redraw loop.

Status: lab. No WinForms counterpart.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit EasingPreview(StableId stable_id)` | Constructs the canonical eight-curve infinite timeline and accessible conformance description. |
| `const std::string& title() const noexcept` | Returns the retained heading. |
| `void set_title(std::string title)` | Commits heading and refreshes paint and semantics. |
| `const BasicControlStyle& style() const noexcept` | Returns the retained visual palette. |
| `void set_style(BasicControlStyle style)` | Commits palette without changing timeline authority. |
| `const AnimationSpec& specification() const noexcept` | Returns the authoritative AnimationTimeline specification. |
| `void set_specification(AnimationSpec specification)` | Validates through AnimationTimeline, restarts/preserves policy coherently, and reconciles the frame lease. |
| `const std::vector<EasingPreviewTrack>& tracks() const noexcept` | Returns ordered curve/label/color track configuration. |
| `void set_tracks(std::vector<EasingPreviewTrack> tracks)` | Requires one through 32 named tracks and refreshes paint and semantics. |
| `MotionPolicy motion_policy() const noexcept` | Returns the caller-authored enabled/paused/reduced policy. |
| `MotionPolicy effective_motion_policy() const noexcept` | Combines authored policy with Window reduced-motion presentation settings. |
| `void set_motion_policy(MotionPolicy policy)` | Commits policy, pauses/resumes without catch-up, and acquires or revokes the single frame lease. |
| `double marker_size() const noexcept` | Returns the logical square marker size. |
| `void set_marker_size(double size)` | Validates a size within \[4, 48\] and refreshes track paint. |
| `double phase() const noexcept` | Returns the last retained normalized timeline phase. |
| `void on_frame(FrameTime now) override` | Samples active timeline state, updates phase, and disconnects when a finite animation finishes. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records frame, title/readout, each track, and curve-sampled markers from effective motion policy. |
| `bool hit_test_local(Point local_point) const override` | Always rejects input because surrounding controls own policy interaction. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects image role, normalized phase/range, motion readout, and busy state only while active. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void on_attached_to_window() override` |  |
| `void on_detached_from_window() noexcept override` |  |

(api-gui-forms-metricsview)=
## MetricsView

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/metrics_view/metrics_view.hpp>
class MetricsView final : public Control
```

MetricsView is an input-transparent diagnostic control over Window's structured metrics snapshot. It formats bounded live counters into a retained card with caller-owned title/style/accent width and group semantics; it does not replace the snapshot as instrumentation authority.

Status: lab. No WinForms counterpart.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit MetricsView(StableId stable_id, std::string title = "Runtime metrics")` | Constructs a titled noninteractive diagnostic projection. |
| `const std::string& title() const noexcept` | Returns the retained diagnostic heading. |
| `void set_title(std::string title)` | Commits title, synchronizes accessible name, and invalidates paint and semantics. |
| `const BasicControlStyle& style() const noexcept` | Returns the compatibility color/style palette used by the card. |
| `void set_style(BasicControlStyle style)` | Commits palette and invalidates paint. |
| `double accent_width() const noexcept` | Returns the logical width of the leading diagnostic rail. |
| `void set_accent_width(double width)` | Validates a width within \[1, 32\] and refreshes paint. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records backplane, accent rail, title, and a bounded two-line Window metrics readout. |
| `bool hit_test_local(Point local_point) const override` | Always rejects input because metrics are observational. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects group role, title, and the current structured metrics readout. |

(api-gui-forms-metrics)=
## Metrics

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/metrics/metrics/metrics.hpp>
class Metrics
```

Metrics is the structured counter accumulator used by Window and retained controls; only wrong-thread rejection is atomic because that rejection may originate off-thread.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `MetricsSnapshot snapshot() const` | Copies retained counters and samples the atomic wrong-thread rejection total. |
| `void reset_activity() noexcept` | Clears transient activity while preserving population, nesting depths, renderer, display cache, and active-surface baselines. |
| `void set_population(std::uint64_t controls, std::uint64_t stable_ids) noexcept` | Sets live control and stable-ID counts. |
| `void record_mutation() noexcept` | Counts one retained mutation. |
| `void record_dirty_mark(double requested_damage_area) noexcept` | Counts a dirty mark and accumulates requested area. |
| `void record_measure(std::uint64_t nodes_visited, std::uint64_t callbacks) noexcept` | Counts one measure pass, visited nodes, and callbacks. |
| `void record_arrange(std::uint64_t nodes_visited, std::uint64_t callbacks) noexcept` | Counts one arrange pass, visited nodes, and callbacks. |
| `void record_paint(std::uint64_t nodes_visited, std::uint64_t controls, std::uint64_t invalidations_consumed, std::uint64_t chunks_rebuilt, std::uint64_t chunks_reused, std::uint64_t commands_replayed, double area, bool full_window) noexcept` | Counts paint traversal, invalidations, display cache work, replay, area, and full/partial classification. |
| `void set_display_cache(std::uint64_t entries, std::uint64_t generation) noexcept` | Sets current cache entries and generation. |
| `void record_input() noexcept` | Counts one input event. |
| `void record_focus_transition() noexcept` | Counts one focus transition. |
| `void record_focus_scope_opened(std::size_t depth) noexcept` | Counts an open, sets depth, and raises maximum depth. |
| `void record_focus_scope_closed(bool restored_focus, std::size_t depth) noexcept` | Counts a close, optional restoration, and resulting depth. |
| `void record_focus_scope_rejection() noexcept` | Counts one rejected focus-scope operation. |
| `void record_activation() noexcept` | Counts one activation transition. |
| `void record_disposal(std::uint64_t count = 1) noexcept` | Adds one or more disposed controls. |
| `void record_wrong_thread_rejection() noexcept` | Atomically counts a rejected cross-thread operation. |
| `void record_subscription_connected() noexcept` | Counts one connected subscription. |
| `void record_subscription_disconnected() noexcept` | Counts one disconnected subscription. |
| `void record_callback_emitted(std::uint64_t count = 1) noexcept` | Adds emitted callback count. |
| `void record_focus_revocation() noexcept` | Counts focus revocation. |
| `void record_capture_revocation() noexcept` | Counts pointer-capture revocation. |
| `void record_press_revocation() noexcept` | Counts press-state revocation. |
| `void record_undeclared_mutation() noexcept` | Counts a mutation outside declared static-tree policy. |
| `void record_damage_region(std::size_t rectangle_count, std::uint64_t compactions, std::uint64_t collapses) noexcept` | Accumulates compaction/collapse work and tracks maximum rectangle cardinality. |
| `void enter_update_scope() noexcept` | Counts and enters one nested update scope. |
| `void leave_update_scope() noexcept` | Leaves one update scope without underflow. |
| `void record_flush(bool read_barrier) noexcept` | Counts a flush and optional read-barrier cause. |
| `void record_pass_limit_hit() noexcept` | Counts bounded layout-pass exhaustion. |
| `void record_callback_arbitration_retry(bool limit_hit) noexcept` | Counts callback arbitration retry and optional limit exhaustion. |
| `void record_frame_request() noexcept` | Counts a scheduled frame request. |
| `void record_frame_poll(std::uint64_t deadlines_fired, std::uint64_t active_surface_ticks, std::uint64_t coalesced_requests) noexcept` | Accumulates deadlines, active ticks, coalescing, and nonempty scheduler wakes. |
| `void record_frame_callback_fault() noexcept` | Counts a contained frame callback exception. |
| `void record_reentrant_frame_poll() noexcept` | Counts a deferred reentrant poll. |
| `void set_active_surface_count(std::size_t count) noexcept` | Sets active surfaces and raises the maximum. |
| `void record_occlusion_transition(bool occluded) noexcept` | Counts occlusion suspension or resumption. |
| `void record_occluded_frame_poll() noexcept` | Counts a poll suppressed by occlusion. |
| `void record_present(std::uint64_t duration_nanoseconds) noexcept` | Counts presentation, total duration, and worst duration. |
| `void set_renderer(std::string_view name, bool cpu_only)` | Sets renderer identity and the explicit CPU-only assertion. |

## VisualPaintOperationSnapshot

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/visual_inspection/types/visual_inspection_types.hpp>
struct VisualPaintOperationSnapshot final
```

One immutable, backend-neutral record from the last committed display chunk. Text is redacted by default at capture time; byte length and the resolved FontSpec remain available for visual diagnosis without copying application content into ordinary diagnostic payloads.
